intent: Simplified replacement icons for 54px / 40px Daily action display. No weapons. One large silhouette and one action mark.

items.name: quest-completed

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent game UI action icon, displayed at only 54 x 54 pixels in a dark frosted-glass panel.
